Simplifying the expression under the limit, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}f}{\text{d}x} & ={lim}_{h\to \,0}\frac{f(x+h)-f(x)}{h} \\  & ={lim}_{h\to \,0}\frac{4-(x+h)^{2}-[4-{x}^{2}]}{h} \\  & ={lim}_{h\to \,0}\frac{4-{x}^{2}-2xh-{h}^{2}-4+{x}^{2}}{h} \\  & ={lim}_{h\to \,0}\frac{-2xh-{h}^{2}}{h} \\  & ={lim}_{h\to \,0}\frac{h(-2x-h)}{h} \\  & ={lim}_{h\to \,0}\frac{\cancel{h}(-2x-h)}{\cancel{h}} \\  & ={lim}_{h\to \,0}(-2x-h).\end{aligned}
$$
